research_findings: Discovered that the authentication and profile features were fragmenting user state due to case-sensitive email lookups using findUnique, causing duplicate entries for differing case strings.
Identified occurrences in auth.ts, session-user.ts, gamification.ts, verify-email/route.ts, submissions.ts, and reset-password/route.ts.
features_improved: Session resolution logic now correctly falls back to a case-insensitive findFirst instead of a case-sensitive findUnique.

Progress update routines (gamification updateProgress/updateStreak, and progress/submissions update) now correctly resolve the user using a case-insensitive email check and then update the user by ID.
Password reset and Email verification routes properly find the user ID using case-insensitive email search prior to doing the update on ID.
next_steps_for_next_run: Review remaining Prisma queries for potentially strict equality cases that could benefit from case-insensitive constraints.
Further migrate away from unique email identifiers towards explicit user ID lookups in all routes.
